title: Quobly and SiPearl Form Partnership to Integrate European ARM CPUs and Silicon Spin QPUs - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quobly and SiPearl signed a non-exclusive MoU to study integrating SiPearl's 80-core ARM Rhea1 CPU with Quobly's silicon spin-qubit QPUs (built on STMicroelectronics' 300mm FD-SOI), forming a European-sourced hybrid HPC-quantum stack. Quobly targets 1M qubits by 2032 and first cloud access in late 2026.

insights.claim: Quobly and SiPearl signed a non-exclusive MoU to evaluate system-level integration of SiPearl's 80-core ARM-based Rhea1 CPU with Quobly's silicon QPU hardware.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Early-stage feasibility study, not a commercial contract; signals intent more than revenue.

insights.claim: The pairing is framed as creating a fully European-sourced hardware pipeline connecting host supercomputing nodes directly to quantum coprocessors.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: EU tech-sovereignty policy creates a protected funding and procurement lane for European quantum/HPC vendors.
insights.locator: The initial phase focuses on interfacing

insights.claim: SiPearl's Rhea1 is targeted for integration into the JUPITER and Alice Recoque exascale hubs.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Exascale installations give a ready deployment path for co-located quantum coprocessors.

insights.claim: The two firms plan joint proposals under EU funding frameworks including the Chips Joint Undertaking on Quantum.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Partnership is partly a vehicle to capture EU subsidy money.

themes.theme: Silicon spin qubits ride CMOS manufacturing

insights.claim: Quobly's spin-qubit processors are built on STMicroelectronics' 300mm FD-SOI platform using VLSI techniques that integrate quantum dot arrays alongside control circuitry.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Leveraging existing semiconductor fabs is the core bull case for spin qubits' scalability versus bespoke modalities.
insights.locator: The initial phase focuses on interfacing

insights.claim: Quobly targets 1 million qubits by 2032, with first cloud access in late 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Aggressive roadmap; late-2026 cloud access is a near-term checkpoint to monitor.

insights.claim: Quobly relies on a domestic European isotopically purified silicon-28 supply chain involving Air Liquide, Soitec and Orano.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Isotope-purified 28Si is a niche chokepoint material; suppliers may gain strategic value.

insights.claim: Quobly closed a €115 million Series A in June 2026 led by Bpifrance, STMicroelectronics and SEALSQ.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Strategic investors (a fab and a security chip firm) indicate industrial rather than purely financial backing.
